take: DAL announced it activated left defenseman Esa Lindell from injured reserve. He has played 10 games this season and carries a 50.6% share of five-on-five expected goals (the quality of chances) with one assist. Going by how the coach has used his players, Nils Lundkvist (18:19 a night) was next in line for Lindell's minutes, so expect Lundkvist's load to ease now that Lindell is back. Lindell averages about 22 minutes a game and kills penalties for a DAL team sitting at 9-5-1.
